342:t_116:2.en:
$$五飛$$
(No matter how many times you drag me back into the darkness, I'll climb out again! I have no more doubts!)

342:t_117:0.en:
$$ゼクス$$
(No matter what methods you use to break my heart, I will keep fighting...!)

342:t_117:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
(I have already thrown away everything...! I will fight only until the one thing I have left, my life, runs out!)

342:t_118:0.en:
$$ノイン$$
(I can hear the voices of the subordinates I lost... Voices cursing my incompetence...)

342:t_118:1.en:
$$ノイン$$
(...Is this too the power of that enemy...? Can humanity win against an enemy like this...?)

342:t_119:0.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
(I'm not scared... I'm not scared...! $$デュオ$$ and everyone are here...!)

342:t_119:1.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
(I-I have to fight...! I have to fight, I have to fight, I have to fight...!)

342:t_120:0.en:
$$桂$$
「Ever since the $$時空震動弾$$, I've been used to things not going my way...!」

342:t_120:1.en:
$$桂$$
「I don't know who you are, but it's pointless to try to make me feel regret or despair! I'll prove it to you!」

342:t_121:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
(Tch... I don't know how it works, but my memories from the $$ファイヤバグ$$ days are coming back vivid as hell...)

342:t_121:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
(...If you're trying to crush me with self-loathing and regret, you've got the wrong guy...)

342:t_121:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
(I've done more than enough of that on my own, until I got sick of it! No matter what anyone says now, I'll just live my own way!)

342:t_122:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「If you're afraid, fall back. People who can't fight...」

342:t_122:4.en:
$n
「I will overcome the fear inside me...! I have until now... and I will from now on...!」

342:t_122:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
(The more despair grows, the more hope grows too... So these $$いがみ合う双子$$ aren't just for show...)

342:t_123:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
(My despair will be felt by everyone aboard this ship...)

342:t_123:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Even if I'm afraid, even if I'm sad, even if I despair, as long as I sit in this seat, I will fulfill my duty as Captain...!)

342:t_123:2.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Because if I lost even that pride, I would no longer be able to go on living)
